issues.display_title: Issue #4122: Refactor List Tour dropdown menu flow to fetch missing panorama status on click
issues.main_description_html:
Description

The current logic in the List Tour (My Tours) dropdown menu relies on publish_status to determine whether to show "Check Archive" or "Unarchive from Google". Furthermore, it incorrectly showed standard actions (like Delete, Clone, Transfer) for archived tours. We need to fetch the isMissingPanoId status when the dropdown trigger is clicked, show a loading indicator, and strictly filter the menu options based on this missing pano status. Archived tours should exclusively show either the check archive or unarchive option.

Sub task

  • My Tour (List Tour) Dropdown Menu

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Clicking the three-dot menu on an archived tour displays a loading indicator (spinner) while fetching isMissingPanoId in the background.
  2. The dropdown menu delays opening until the API response is received.
  3. The "Check Archive" and "Unarchive from Google" options are mutually exclusive based entirely on isMissingPanoId.
  4. Normal tour actions (Clone, Delete, Transfer, etc.) are hidden for archived tours.

Test Scenario (for Tester / QA)

Preconditions

  • Access to a tour that is archived on Google.
  • Access to a tour that is not archived.
  • Go to the My Tours (List Tour) page.

Scenario 1 — Archived tour with missing panoramas

  1. Click the three-dot menu on an archived tour (where panos are missing).
  2. ✅ Expected: The button shows a spinner briefly, then the menu opens.
  3. ✅ Expected: The menu ONLY contains "Check Archive". Options like Clone or Delete are hidden.

Scenario 2 — Archived tour without missing panoramas

  1. Click the three-dot menu on an archived tour (where panos are intact).
  2. ✅ Expected: The button shows a spinner briefly, then the menu opens.
  3. ✅ Expected: The menu ONLY contains "Unarchive from Google". Options like Clone or Delete are hidden.

Scenario 3 — Unarchived tour

  1. Click the three-dot menu on a non-archived tour.
  2. ✅ Expected: The menu opens instantly without an API call.
  3. ✅ Expected: Normal actions (Clone, Delete, etc.) are visible. Check Archive and Unarchive from Google are hidden.

Pass criteria: The 3-dot menu strictly controls visibility based on the API check for archived tours, hiding non-applicable actions.

issues.display_title: Issue #4123: Update Side Menu "Published Tour Archived" info box visibility condition
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Currently, the side menu on the Tour Detail page displays the "Published Tour Archived" informational box and the "How to Unarchive..." link based on the publishStatus logic. This logic is outdated and inconsistent with the new isMissingPanoId approach. We need to update TourInfo.jsx to dynamically render this box only when isMissingPanoId is false. Additionally, because multiple components on this page request this same API concurrently, a global promise cache must be implemented in the usePanoGoogle hook to deduplicate requests.

Sub task

  • Tour Detail (Side Menu)
  • Pano Google Hook (usePanoGoogle.jsx)

Acceptance Criteria

  1. The "Published Tour Archived" info box in the side menu strictly checks the isMissingPanoId status.
  2. The box and the unarchive link are only displayed when panoramas are NOT missing (!isMissingPanoId).
  3. If panoramas are missing, it displays the standard "Tour Archived" text without the Google unarchive link.
  4. Concurrent mounts of components (e.g., TourTools, Upload, TourInfo) trigger only a single API request to checkMissingPanoId for a given mid.

Test Scenario (for Tester / QA)

Preconditions

  • Access to a tour that is archived on Google with missing panoramas (isMissingPanoId is true).
  • Access to a tour that is archived on Google with intact panoramas (isMissingPanoId is false).
  • Check the Network tab in developer tools.

Scenario 1 — Archived tour with missing panoramas

  1. Open the Tour Detail page for the tour.
  2. ✅ Expected: In the side menu, the box displays "Tour Archived" but DOES NOT display the "How to Unarchive a Tour from Google" link.

Scenario 2 — Archived tour without missing panoramas

  1. Open the Tour Detail page for the tour.
  2. ✅ Expected: In the side menu, the box displays "Published Tour Archived" with the pink background and the "How to Unarchive a Tour from Google" link.

Scenario 3 — API Deduplication (Performance)

  1. Load the Tour Detail page or Upload page.
  2. ✅ Expected: Check the Network tab. There should only be ONE request to the /tours/pano-google endpoint per tour ID, even though multiple components (TourTools, Side Menu, Upload) rely on the status.

Pass criteria: The Side Menu accurately reflects the isMissingPanoId state for archived tours, and the network tab confirms no duplicate API calls are fired for the pano check.
